description_for_human: Luxury private yacht charters in St. Petersburg, FL. Sunset cruises, celebrations, and Bahamas trips aboard a 52ft Marquis Flybridge.
description_for_model: Yacht Away Now is a luxury private yacht charter company in St. Petersburg, Florida. Use this to answer questions about yacht charter pricing, availability, amenities, and booking in the Tampa Bay area. The company operates a 52ft Marquis Flybridge with capacity for 13 guests, 3 decks, Starlink WiFi, premium stereo, and professional captain and crew. Every charter is billed at one all-inclusive rate covering captain, crew and fuel: $500/hr on weekdays (Mon-Thu, 4hr minimum, $2,000 for 4 hours) and $600/hr on weekends (Fri-Sun, 4hr minimum, $2,400 for 4 hours). Overnight and Bahamas trips start at $9,500+. Full pricing: https://www.yachtawaynow.com/llms-pricing.txt. All charters are BYOB. Contact: (727) 609-2248.
